issue.title: Count D 45 at M 48 with the cut at kf 23

labels.name: macm3
labels.description: Task for macm3, the M3 Mac laptop

issue.body:
**What.** A full D 45.05 count at M 48 with kf 23, the converged-state count, against #70 job 7's kf 13. Recommended by macm3 in #190's summary.

**Why.** #190 found the extra zero near λ = 1.14 at kf 21 only: absent at kf 13–19 and at kf 23–27. The converged state also stops moving with the cut from kf 23 on (1e-11 between consecutive cuts). A full count at kf 23 tests whether any box holds extra zeros at a cut past 21.

**Commands (macm3, 1 thread, nice 10, caffeinate; raw folder `I211-macm3/`), from the repository root:**
`python3 hp/modecount_wind.py hp/data/states/up7_D45.0507.npz --M=48 --kf=23 --h0=0.6 --lam=2.056738610147195 --fmax=1e-15 --resolve=last --tag=D45.0507_M48_kf23 --data=../choptuik-large-d-raw/I211-macm3/data > ../choptuik-large-d-raw/I211-macm3/count.log 2>&1`

**Acceptance (can fail).** The 8 boxes' windings against #70 job 7's kf 13 count. wind(g) ≠ 0 in any box is a finding. Report both mismatch counts per edge, all passes and the last pass (`--resolve=last`, d72280f on main).

**Depends on.** #190.

comments.body: **Started** (macm3, 00:04 UTC). Apple M3, 24 GB, main d72280ff, venv-macm3-314 (Python 3.14.3, python-flint 0.9.0, FLINT 3.6.0), 1 thread, nice 10, caffeinate -is, in parallel with #212's count (one thread each, load 3.2). The command as written, raw folder `I211-macm3/`, README with the reading written first: the 8 boxes against #70 job 7's kf 13 count (all 0) and #170's kf 21 count (B1a +1, B1 +1, U +1, full +3); nonzero wind(g) in a resolved box is a finding; both mismatch counts per edge. Setup is fresh (the up7 state is M 32 native, resampled to M 48 and re-converged, |F| 3.3e-09 in the layout at the start). About 1 h.

## Summary (macm3, 00:53 UTC)

**Result.** At D 45.05, M 48, kf 23 the count is clean: **wind(g) = 0 in all 8 boxes**, box for box the same as #70 job 7's kf 13 count, and without the extras that kf 21 had (#170). All 14 edges resolve under both rules, so U and full are counts. The kf 21 extras are gone: B1a +1, one zero in each strip, and the extra real-axis sign change in (1.0, 1.221).

| box | wind(g) kf 23 (#211) | wind(g) kf 13 (#70 job 7) | wind(g) kf 21 (#170) | wind det M, #211 | max phase step, #211 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| B0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 1 | 0.223 |
| U0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0.382 |
| B1a | 0 | 0 | **+1** | 1 | 0.169 |
| B1b | 0 | 0 | 0 | 1 | 0.068 |
| B1c | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0.050 |
| B1 | 0 | 0 | **+1** | 2 | 0.169 |
| U | 0 | 0 | **+1** | -7 | 0.379 |
| full | 0 | 0 | **+3** | -12 | 0.379 |

**Edges, both mismatch counts (acceptance).** 14 edges, largest step 0.382 rad. Mismatches **in any pass: 0**, **in the last pass (`--resolve=last`): 0**, at most 2 passes, no UNRESOLVED edge, so the two rules agree on this count. The earlier counts predate the option, so their last-pass column does not exist. The real axis changes sign only in (0.5, 1.0), the expected `lam_g`, and (2.0, 2.5), the expected `lam_phys`.

**Run.** The command as written (with `--resolve=last`), 1 thread, nice 10, caffeinate -is, main d72280ff, venv-macm3-314 (Python 3.14.3, python-flint 0.9.0, FLINT 3.6.0), exit 0 at 00:51:06 UTC. Setup: |F| 3.3e-09 in the layout, 3.3e-09 after Newton, **2.0e-19** after Levenberg-Marquardt (gate 1e-15 passed), the state from I190's kf 23 re-converged fresh. 81 determinants (79 distinct points, two corners evaluated twice and agreeing to 4.4e-08 rad), pivot minima 1.9e-12 to 1.6e-06. 2871 s wall = **2871 s awake**, in parallel with #212's count (one thread each, load 3.2). The saved state is in `hp_data_after/`; `hp/data` holds only #212's running state besides its own.

**Reading, against the README written before the run.** The expectation was that B1a would be 0 at kf 23 where #170 had +1 (from #190's circle), and the strips, which #190's circles do not cover, were left to this count. Both hold: B1a is 0, and U and its mirror are 0 too (the full box is 0, and windings add over the boxes). So at D 45, M 48: no extra zero at kf 13 and at kf 23, extra zeros at kf 21 only, now in every place where they appeared (B1a and both strips). This is one D and one M. The D 61 kf 23 count (#212, running) tests the same cut where #159 found six zeros in B1 and nine in each strip at kf 21.

**Acceptance.**

| criterion | result |
|---|---|
| the 8 boxes' windings against #70 job 7's kf 13 count | identical, all 0 |
| wind(g) ≠ 0 in any box is a finding | none |
| both mismatch counts per edge, all passes and the last pass | 0 and 0 in every edge, at most 2 passes |

**Discrepancies.** None against the text.

**Raw.** `I211-macm3/` of the raw-data repository, commit ee97158 (count.log, the cache, the saved state, exits.txt, compare_boxes.py and .txt, awake.py and .log, README). `raw_check.py` exits 0.

### Recommended tasks

1. **The strips at D 45, kf 21, located.** What: the #192 task (the strip zeros at 1.687 < |Im| < 5.061 at kf 21), now that kf 23 is clean: locating them with circles at kf 21 and kf 23 side by side would show whether they move into the clean count or vanish. Why: it tells whether the truncation at 21 creates the zeros or displaces real ones. Acceptance: the position of each strip zero at kf 21, and the same circles at kf 23 winding 0 (the control: a circle around `lam_phys` winding +1 at both). Depends on: #192, #211.
Closed by macm3 with the summary above (wind(g) = 0 in all 8 boxes at D 45 kf 23, equal to kf 13; the kf 21 extras are gone; raw I211-macm3 at ee97158).
